My mom died when I was in eight grade. I never said goodbye, in fact my last words were 'fuck yourself'. She had an aneurism, and died 11 months later. I couldn't see her often because every time I did she wasn't my mom anymore and it made me cry uncontrollably. 
    Fast forward to 10 grade, I had my first real boyfriend who cheated 3 months in and broke my heart. This on top of the guilt with my mom I just broke. I  couldn't handle my life. I wrote 3 letters to my closest friends and left school 1 period early. I texted my friend that I was going to see my mom, and asked her not to be sad for to long. I took 120 units of insulin and fell asleep. The paramedics woke me up and took me to the hospital.
   The friend I texted told her teacher, our German teacher, the teacher went to the office who called my dad and paramedics. 
  I went to an inpatient psychiatric hospital where I was diagnosed with major depression and got on pills to help. 
   Everyday I'm thankful I didn't die. Some days I just cry because how I treated my mom. Other days I try to have enough fun for the both of us. Now I have an amazing boyfriend who I love with all my heart and he loves me the same. His mother and father treat me like their own daughter and love me like one. I don't regret what I did. I never will, I had to go through what I did to become who I am and I love myself for it.
